complexity_ledger.narrative: Path: specs/results/scorecards/subtract-to-measure/SM-03-RESULTS.md, read against specs/results/scorecards/subtract-to-measure/after-state/instrument-sweep-after.md and its before-state counterpart. NOTHING WAS DELETED, AND THE TICKET'S STATED DEFAULT WAS DELETION. FI-06 said twelve pytest failing slots assert only `expect_exit = 0`, "which pytest returns for a passing run and a fully skipped one". SM-01 seeded both skip shapes and measured the sentence: a module-level skip collects nothing, pytest exits 5, and those slots ALREADY went red. Only a pytestmark skip -- collected then skipped, exit 0 -- reported `ok`. So the hole is a demonstration that goes VACUOUS, not one that DISAPPEARS, and the twelve are UNCOUNTED rather than hollow. A hollow instrument should be deleted; an uncounted one should be counted. All twelve repaired, zero deleted. THE MEASURED ALTERNATIVE THAT WAS REJECTED, and it is the one that would have flattered the number. `ticket-state-agreement` is classified `no-instrument-exists`, watches nothing, and SM-01 recorded that "the removal's cost is already paid in full". Deleting that one row would have moved the ratio from 33/47 to 33/46 by arithmetic alone, with no instrument gained and none lost. That is `denominator_rule`'s exact prohibition -- a ratio that rises because the denominator shrank -- and taking it while reporting a falling ratio elsewhere would have been laundering one number through another. The row stays and stays counted. THE COUNT MOVED THE OTHER WAY. 26 of 35 -> 33 of 47; the ratio FELL from 74.3% to 70.2%. Numerator +7 = 5 new rows carrying a demonstration + 2 repairs of rows whose "no-demonstration-constructible" SM-GM-I4 showed was a fact about demonstrate.py shelling pytest at REPO_ROOT rather than about the instrument. Denominator +12, from the eighteen executables the enumeration could not see. FI-06 said "at least eight"; a derived check found eighteen on its first run, including demonstrate.py itself and run_gap_mutants.py, which SM-01 shipped unregistered in this same epic. THE LARGEST PART OF THE WORK MOVES NO FIGURE. Repairing a slot that reported `ok` for the wrong reason so that it reports `ok` for the right one reads identically in the count. The only evidence it changed is SM-GM-I1, which survived the registry at SM-01 and dies against it now: "0 test(s) passed, declared exactly 4" and "4 test(s) SKIPPED, declared 0". THE REGISTRY BLIND SPOT, fixed without lengthening a list. `required <= enumerated` over thirteen literal paths is DELETED, not extended -- that shape was rejected at EVAL-RERUN-DF-01 and again at ARM_MODULE_PREFIXES, and is worse here because the literal must be edited by whoever just forgot to register the instrument. [registry.enumeration] declares a scope and the members are derived by walking the tree. SM-GM-I3 flips SURVIVES -> DIES. The check measures a tree it is HANDED, never the one it lives in, because SM-01 found the gap-mutant runner detecting itself. Findings SM-03-DF-01..03 filed, none fixed, budget 5 spent 3. The load-bearing one: demonstrate.py judges an EXIT CODE where run_gap_mutants.py one directory over compares FAILURE SETS against a pristine baseline, which is why the last two tripwires still cannot be demonstrated -- one layer of "the reason was about the harness" was peeled off and another was found underneath.

refinement.detail: SEARCHED, FOUND NONE. SM-03's model_delta_expectation is `none expected` and the measured delta is zero: this ticket adds no action, no variable and no state to TlaSpecDevCli.tla, because everything it touches lives under `examples/validation/instruments/`, `tests/` and `specs/results/`, none of which is modeled surface. ONE CANDIDATE WAS CONSIDERED AND REJECTED, and it is the one the issue itself proposes. FI-04's suggested fix for the registry blind spot was to put the obligation on `close ticket`: refuse when a diff adds an executable under a declared instrument root and the registry gained no row. That WOULD have been a model delta -- a new precondition on an existing CLI action, which is exactly the shape TlaSpecDevCli.tla represents. It was rejected on `no_new_gates_rule`: four epics of static checking caught zero bugs, and subtraction is not licence to add a refusal on the product's close path. What shipped instead is a repair of a check that already existed, in the repository's own suite, refusing nothing about the product and consulted by no close path. Nothing in the recursive-refinement sense was found to collapse.

ticket.objective: Twelve pytest failing slots assert only expect_exit = 0, which a FULLY SKIPPED run satisfies -- false precision, worse than an empty slot because the count reads as coverage. Two rows have failing.nodes == passing.nodes. At least eight instruments are absent from the registry including demonstrate.py itself. DELETION IS THE DEFAULT: an instrument that cannot be shown to fail is not an instrument. ONE EXCEPTION, stated so it is not cut by mistake -- scripts/code_complexity.py correctly cannot fail, because it is a thermometer. Fix the registry's blind spot WITHOUT lengthening the hardcoded list; that shape was rejected at EVAL-RERUN-DF-01 and at ARM_MODULE_PREFIXES.
